description: This Java source file defines the CatalinaContainer class, which manages the lifecycle and configuration of an embedded Tomcat server within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and configuring Tomcat components such as connectors, hosts, clustering, and web applications.

classes.name: CatalinaContainer
classes.description: Implements the Container interface to manage an embedded Tomcat server, including initialization, startup, shutdown, and web application deployment within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Tomcat server with configuration, sets up hosts, realm, clustering, valves, connectors, and loads web applications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Tomcat server and logs the status of connectors and server info.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Tomcat server gracefully, with verbose logging on exceptions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this container instance.

search-terms: Tomcat host and virtual host setup
